motore.danneggiata: damaged or incomplete file: copy the photo again (the program rereads it by itself) or remove it from the folder
motore.formato_non_supportato: {formato} format isn't supported: export it as one of the formats that open (JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, HEIC)
motore.non_si_apre: the file doesn't open as a photo
motore.originale_non_trovato: {nome}: the original can't be found (relink the photo)
motore.photoshop_linux: PSDs are created with Photoshop, which isn't available for Linux: export to JPG or PDF (or open the project on a Mac or a Windows PC with Photoshop)
motore.photoshop_mac: Photoshop wasn't found in /Applications: it's needed to create PSDs (JPG and PDF work without it)
motore.photoshop_windows: Photoshop wasn't found in the Program Files\Adobe folder: it's needed to create PSDs (JPG and PDF work without it)
motore.psd_esiste: it exists and I didn't generate it
motore.psd_modificato: it was edited by hand after it was generated
motore.psd_registro_illeggibile: psd_generati.json can't be read ({motivo}): I'll rebuild it
motore.psd_saltato: Skipped spread {n}: {motivo} -> use modifica_psd.py or --forza if the user really wants to regenerate it
motore.troppo_grande: {nome}: photo too large (over {milioni} million pixels; change the limit with IMPAGINATORE_MAX_MPIXEL)
